skipped.reason: no card in Forge's cardsfolder has more than one instance of enlist, so independent triggering of several instances cannot be reached in a game

scenarios.title: An attacking creature enlists an eligible creature and gets its power

setup.notes: Barkweave Crusher (2/5, enlist) and Hill Giant (3/3) have both been under A's control since earlier turns. B controls no creatures.

decisions: A moves to combat and declares only Barkweave Crusher as an attacker.
As it attacks, A pays the enlist cost by tapping Hill Giant, if Hill Giant is eligible.
The enlist trigger resolves, if it fired. B declares no blockers. Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: giant_enlisted
variants.expected: Hill Giant becomes tapped (it does not attack). The enlist trigger fires and Barkweave Crusher gets +3/+0 until end of turn, becoming 5/5. It deals 5 combat damage: B is at 15.

variants.label: giant_summoning_sick
variants.delta: Hill Giant entered the battlefield this turn (summoning sick, no haste).
variants.expected: Hill Giant is not eligible to be tapped for enlist. No enlist trigger fires. Barkweave Crusher stays 2/5, deals 2 combat damage: B is at 18. Hill Giant stays untapped.

variants.label: giant_already_tapped
variants.expected: Hill Giant is not an untapped creature, so it cannot be tapped for enlist. No enlist trigger fires. Barkweave Crusher stays 2/5, deals 2 combat damage: B is at 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variants change the state of Hill Giant in the setup: use summoning_sick true or tapped true on its entry.
